h1: Best skip hire in Leeds: 3 local skip companies
list_label: local skip hire firms in Leeds
checks: Ask for the full price, including the permit if the skip goes on the road, VAT and any weight or overfill charges.
Check the firm is a registered waste carrier on the Environment Agency public register.
Tell them about plasterboard, tyres, fridges or soil before booking, as many skips cannot take them or charge extra.

expert_tip.src: Leeds City Council: Licences and permits for the highway
expert_tip.body: A skip on a road or pavement in Leeds needs a permit, and only a skip company registered with the council can apply for it. Applications made before 9am on a weekday are reviewed that day, later ones the next working day. The licence fee is charged once the permit is issued, even if you then cancel, so be sure of your dates before you book.

p: Many of the websites you find for skip hire in Leeds are brokers. They take your booking and pass it to whichever local firm is free, often for a higher price. The three firms above run their own lorries and yards in Leeds, so you deal with the company that delivers the skip.
Before booking, decide where the skip will go. On your drive or private land you do not need a permit. On the road or pavement you do, and the skip firm applies for it.

guide.h2: Skip sizes and what fits in them
p: Skip companies measure skips in cubic yards. As a rough guide from Checkatrade's 2026 skip hire guide, a 4 yard skip holds about 30 to 40 bin bags and a 5 yard skip about 40 to 50.
ul: Mini skip (2 to 3 yards): garden waste, a small bathroom refit
Midi skip (4 to 5 yards): a kitchen refit or a room clear out
Builders skip (6 to 8 yards): bricks, rubble and heavy building waste
Maxi skip (12 yards and up): bulky, light waste from a house clearance, not heavy rubble

p: If the skip has to go on the road or pavement, Leeds City Council needs to issue a licence first. The council's own guidance says the application must come from a registered skip company, and the fee is charged once the licence is issued. National cost guides put council skip permits at roughly £15 to £70, but Leeds does not publish its fee on that page, so ask your skip firm for the exact amount. Read the rules on the Leeds City Council licences and permits page.
Skips on the road also need lights and markings at night. Checkatrade's guide warns that missing permits or markings can lead to fines of up to £1,000.

guide.h2: What you cannot put in a skip
p: Most skip firms will not take hazardous waste. Check with the firm first, but these are usually banned or charged extra:
ul: Asbestos, including old garage roof sheets (see asbestos removal in Leeds)
Fridges, freezers, TVs and other electrical items
Tyres, gas bottles, batteries and paint

guide.h2: How much does skip hire cost in Leeds?
p: Prices in the north of England are lower than in the south. Checkatrade's 2026 guide gives northern prices of about £65 to £110 for a 2 to 3 yard skip, £120 to £240 for a 4 to 5 yard skip and £250 to £320 for an 8 yard skip. MyBuilder adds that wait and load usually costs £20 to £50 and overfilling a skip can add £10 to £40. See our full skip hire cost guide for Leeds.

For a small amount of rubbish, a man and van clearance or the council can work out cheaper than a skip. Leeds City Council runs household waste sites and an unwanted items collection, with one free collection a year. For a full house, see rubbish removal and house clearance in Leeds.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit for a skip in Leeds?
faqs.a: Only if the skip goes on a public road or pavement. On your drive or private land you do not. The skip company applies to Leeds City Council for you.

faqs.q: What size skip do I need for a kitchen refit?
faqs.a: A 4 to 5 yard midi skip is usually enough for a kitchen. Checkatrade puts the average UK price for that size at about £225 a week.

faqs.q: Can I hire a skip for a day?
faqs.a: Most firms hire skips by the week, but wait and load is a good option if you only need an hour or two. The lorry waits while you fill the skip and then takes it away.

faqs.q: Is VAT charged on skip hire?
faqs.a: Yes, skip hire is normally subject to VAT. Ask whether the price you are quoted includes it.

faqs.q: Can I put asbestos in a skip?
faqs.a: No. Asbestos needs to be wrapped and taken to a licensed site. Leeds householders can take small amounts to the council's Kirkstall site by appointment.
